The '''Three Bears''' are a group of [[NPC]]s found in the [[Crystal Hollows]]. They begin as '''Pete''', '''Keith''', and '''Ede''' and tell the player a story. At the end of the story, the player is given the blindness effect and the NPCs turn into bears and disappear.

Once they have been spoken to, Pete will have a chance to visit the player's [[The Garden|Garden]] in his bear form.
